text:
I'm working on a better way to design longer scrolling pages with multiple sections, while preserving the visual look/feel and drastically speeding up the experience.

Here's a demo: https://non.io/video/linen-demo.mp4

As a disclaimer I cut 32 seconds of generation time out of that video, but still I'm quite happy with the speed. Not launched yet, but it's been fun to work on / wanted to show off progress :)
